name: Applications merchant-name search reconciles matching results and shows empty state for unknown
description:
Objective: Applications merchant-name search reconciles complete filtered empty and restored result sets.
Preconditions: QA has an existing application whose API owner name supplies a searchable token.
Steps:
1. Derive a Merchant token from the initial API response.
2. Search it and reconcile every API item and rendered row.
3. Search a generated unknown value and require an authoritative empty response plus UI empty state.
4. Clear search and require the complete response and row identities to equal the original listing.
Expected: Dynamic Merchant search fully reconciles matching empty and restored states without hard-coded mutable Merchant data.
